title: Gapped graphene model: Berry phases and Chern number
summary: The honeycomb model with a sublattice gap (t = -1 eV, delta = -0.2 eV): bands, the Berry phase of each band and of both on circles around K', its dependence on the radius of the loop (gapped and gapless graphene), and the Chern number of the lower band from the Berry flux through the whole zone. No DFT run; about a minute.

steps.label: Bands, Berry phases and Chern number of gapped graphene
steps.note: writes graphene/ and gapless/ (bands, Berry phases on circles, plaquette phases)
